load_mpii_annotations: load MPII format annotations and convert them to instance and image lists for pose estimation
convert_keypoints_mpii_to_goliath: convert MPII keypoints to Goliath dataset format using SOURCE_TO_TARGET_INDICES mapping
transform_bbox_center_scale_to_xyxy: transform MPII center and scale bounding boxes to xyxy format using bbox_cs2xyxy
create_mpii2goliath_dataset: create an Mpii2GoliathDataset instance registered in the MMPose DATASETS registry for training
map_source_to_target_keypoints: map source MPII keypoints to target Goliath keypoints using SOURCE_KEYPOINT_ORDER and TARGET_KEYPOINT_ORDER
